Portuguese Compliance

We know the regulations.
So you don't have to.

Short-term letting in Portugal requires specific licences, registrations and ongoing compliance. We manage all of it as standard — not as an add-on.

01

AL Licence (Alojamento Local)

Mandatory for all short-term rentals in Portugal. We guide owners through the full application process with the local Câmara Municipal, including required safety checks.

02

SIBA Guest Registration

Portuguese law requires all guests to be registered with immigration authorities (AIMA) within 3 working days of check-in. We manage this for every booking, every time.

03

AT Income Registration

AL income must be declared to the Portuguese Tax Authority. We provide clear records and work alongside your accountant or tax advisor to ensure compliance.

04

Safety Requirements

AL properties must have a fire extinguisher, fire blanket, first aid kit, emergency contact numbers displayed, and a Livro de Reclamações (complaints book) accessible to guests.

05

AL Insurance

Specific liability insurance is required for all AL-registered properties. We can advise on appropriate cover and ensure your property meets the minimum legal requirement.

06

NIF & Condominium Rules

Non-resident owners require a Portuguese NIF (tax number) before registration. In apartment buildings, we check condominium rules carefully — post-2023 legislation means AL may be restricted.

Invest in Portugal

Why the Algarve remains one of Europe's most compelling property investments.

Portugal's golden coast isn't just a beautiful place to spend time. For the right buyer, it's a genuinely attractive investment — with strong rental yields, a robust tourist market, and a lifestyle that makes the numbers feel worth it even before you run them.

Why Portugal

Eight reasons serious investors are choosing the Algarve.

📈

Strong STR Demand

The Algarve attracts over 10 million visitors annually. Peak season occupancy for well-managed properties regularly exceeds 90% — with growing shoulder season demand extending the earning window.

💶

Competitive Entry Prices

Compared to equivalent coastal markets in Spain, France or Italy, the Algarve still offers relative value — particularly in the western stretch, where prices remain below the central Algarve despite comparable beauty.

✈️

Excellent Connectivity

Faro Airport connects directly to over 60 UK and European cities, with under 3 hours flying time from most of the UK. Easy access means strong year-round demand from a wide catchment.

⚖️

Stable Legal Framework

Portugal has clear, established property ownership laws for non-residents. The AL licence system, while requiring compliance, provides a regulated and legitimate framework for short-term letting.

🌤️

Year-Round Climate

Unlike much of northern Europe, the Algarve offers genuinely mild winters — attracting digital nomads, retirees and longer-stay guests outside peak summer. October to April is increasingly bookable.

🧘

The Lifestyle Premium

Many Algarve investors aren't purely chasing yield — they want a property they love to use themselves. The Algarve delivers on both counts. That combination narrows the supply of quality stock, which supports values.

🏗️

Renovation Opportunity

Character properties — original tiles, high ceilings, thick stone walls — remain available at prices that make renovation-to-let a realistic strategy, particularly in inland villages and smaller coastal towns.

🤝

We're Already There

The Algarve Collective is based in Portugal and actively managing in the region. For buyers who want on-the-ground expertise — from property selection through to lettings management — we're the partner in place.

On Tax — A Note

Portugal's tax landscape for non-habitual residents (NHR) changed in 2024 with the introduction of the IFICI regime. Tax planning for Algarve property investment and residency is complex and personal — we strongly recommend working with a qualified Portuguese tax advisor before making decisions. We can make introductions to advisors we trust.
